title: Momo's Mod
description: Adds Flying Lemurs to MC! Momo's Mod!
body:
Adds Flying Lemurs to MC!
Tame them, equip armor with colored gems, and explore with your loyal gliding companion.
How to Use Momo's Mod

Finding Lemurs


    Flying Lemurs spawn naturally in jungles, mountains, and occasionally across the Overworld

    Use a Spawn Egg (Creative tab) to spawn one manually


Taming


    Feed a wild Flying Lemur its favorite food to tame it

    Once tamed, it will follow you and roam nearby when you're standing still


Armor & Gems


    Craft lemur armor using phantom membrane, feathers, and the corresponding material (leather, iron, gold, diamond)

    Equip armor by right-clicking the lemur with the armor item

    A colored gem appears on the lemur's forehead matching the armor type

    Sneak + left-click an armored lemur to remove its armor

    Armor tiers: Leather → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Netherite (via smithing table)

    Netherite armor gives the strongest regeneration


Regeneration


    Armored lemurs passively regenerate health over time

    Higher-tier armor = faster regeneration (Netherite is fastest)


Commands


    /momo here
    — Teleports all your tamed lemurs in the current dimension to your location


Flying


    Lemurs glide through the air with their wing membranes

    Tamed lemurs will fly to keep up with you
